sym_neck_l_lump: A lump in the neck can be from enlarged lymph nodes or benign causes. If it's new or growing, please consult your clinician for examination.
sym_neck_r_lump: A lump in the neck can be from enlarged lymph nodes or benign causes. If it's new or painful, seek clinical review.
sym_arm_l_lump: Lumps in the armpit are often related to lymph nodes or benign cysts. Track size and pain; see a doctor if it persists.
sym_arm_r_lump: Lumps in the armpit can be benign but should be checked if persistent or painful.
sym_breast_l_pain: Breast pain is commonly cyclical or hormonal, but new persistent pain should be reviewed by a clinician.
sym_breast_l_palpable: A palpable lump in the breast needs clinical evaluation and imaging; please arrange an appointment with your care team.
sym_breast_l_changes_shape: Changes in breast shape or appearance merit clinical examination and imaging to rule out concerning causes.
sym_breast_l_wound: Wounds or skin changes on the breast should be assessed promptly by a clinician.
sym_breast_l_nipple_discharge: Nipple discharge can have benign causes but should be evaluated, especially if unilateral or bloody.
sym_breast_r_pain: Breast pain is often non-cancerous but new, persistent pain should be checked by your doctor.
sym_breast_r_palpable: A palpable breast abnormality should be assessed with clinical exam and imaging.
sym_breast_r_changes_shape: Any asymmetric changes in shape need a clinical review and possibly imaging.
sym_breast_r_wound: Breast skin wounds or ulcers require urgent clinical attention.
sym_breast_r_nipple_discharge: Nipple discharge, especially unilateral or bloody, should be evaluated by a clinician.
sym_resp_cough: A persistent cough may need evaluation, especially if it is new, worsening, or accompanied by breathlessness.
sym_resp_breathlessness: Breathlessness should be assessed promptly; if it comes on suddenly or is severe, seek medical attention.
sym_cns_headache: Headaches are common but new or severe headaches should be discussed with your clinician.
sym_cns_nausea: Nausea may have many causes; if it is persistent or severe, consult a healthcare provider.
sym_cns_giddiness: Giddiness or dizziness can be important to track and may require clinical assessment if frequent or severe.
sym_cns_vomiting: Vomiting should be evaluated if it is recurrent, severe, or accompanied by other concerning symptoms.
sym_cns_convulsion: Convulsions are a medical emergency and require immediate clinical evaluation.
sym_msk_back_pain: Back pain should be monitored; if it is severe or persistent, seek medical advice.
sym_msk_shoulder_pain: Shoulder pain may be musculoskeletal; see a clinician if it limits movement or worsens.
sym_msk_underarm_pain: Underarm pain can be related to muscular or lymph node causes; follow up with your care team if it persists.
default_fallback: I can help explain platform features and general breast-health information. For medical decisions or new symptoms, please contact your care team directly.
